The 1962–63 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]] was the 29th season of [[Portuguese football league system|top-tier]] [[Association football|football]] in Portugal.

==Overview==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] won the championship.
